headline: What Has Passed: Trump Said He Would Declare the Strait of Hormuz US Territory; Pezeshkian Spoke of Declining Oil Revenues and a New Wave of Price Increases
summary: Trump said he would soon declare the Strait of Hormuz US territory after Iran's defeat and asked Americans to accept higher gasoline prices. Iran's president spoke of declining oil revenues.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key transit route for global oil shipments, so threats to its status directly affect energy supply risk.
why_moved: Threats over the Strait of Hormuz, a key oil transit route, raise perceived supply risk, which typically lifts crude prices.
